The headphones arrived, but they don’t work at all. I paid once for them and would like my money returned.
I’m unhappy with the meal-kit box and don’t want to continue, so I’d like the $52 payment back. I got two order emails, though my bank only shows one payment.

I paid for the hotel night and then had to cancel because my flight was called off. There’s just one $180 entry on my card, but could you return it? I also received a second confirmation email and wasn’t sure if that meant anything.
My account shows two $48 entries for the same order, but one is marked pending. Can you look into it? I’m not sure whether one will drop off or whether some of the money needs to come back.
There are two $29 lines next to the same app subscription in my statement, and I don’t remember authorizing both. Could you check what happened and let me know how this should be resolved?
I see two completed $74 payments for the same concert tickets. Please return the extra one—though if the second entry is just a temporary hold, I’m happy to wait for it to clear.
My grocery order appears twice on my card, both for $63, and I only placed it once. I’d like the extra amount back, unless one of those lines is just pending and will disappear.
I bought one desk lamp for $31, but my statement has two completed $31 payments for that exact order. I haven’t made any other purchase from your store.
The same $12 monthly membership payment posted twice today, and both entries are settled. I only have one membership and just want the account corrected.
My subscription renewal was declined this morning, and my account now says I need to pay. Could you check what happened to the charge?
I got a notice that last night’s invoice wasn’t paid because the transaction was rejected. I haven’t changed anything on my account—can you help me get the charge through?
My renewal didn’t go through on the card I have saved, even though I thought it was still good. Could you check why it was rejected? I can use a different card if that’s what it takes.
The monthly charge bounced, and now I can’t access my plan. I may need to use another card, but first could you tell me why this one didn’t work?
I received a billing alert about the card on my account, but I can’t tell what needs attention. Could you help me figure out the next step?
There’s a warning beside my card details, and I’m not sure whether the charge needs another try or the details need changing. Can someone take a look?
I’d like to replace the card saved on my account with a new one. A recent charge didn’t seem to go through, so I want to make sure the right card is there for the next attempt.
Can you help me switch the card used for my subscription? The last billing notice said something went wrong, and I’d rather have future charges go to my other card.
Please replace the card saved to my account with my new Visa. I want all future subscription charges to use that one.
I’m moving my bills to PayPal and would like to use it for this account instead of the card I have on file. Where can I make that change?
Every time I click Save, a red banner says “Unable to save changes.” The document stays open, but nothing gets saved.
Checkout won't go through—the screen says “Payment method declined” even though my card works elsewhere. I can dismiss the notice and keep browsing.
When I start uploading a photo, the window freezes for a few seconds and a box says “Upload failed.” It comes back to normal after I close the box.
I hit Submit and the screen flickers black for a moment, then shows “Request timed out.” The form is still there, but my entry didn't go through.
I tap Sync, see a brief “Couldn't complete sync” notice, and then I'm back at my phone's home screen. I'm not sure whether the sync failed first or the app disappeared first.
I choose Export, a small “Export unsuccessful” notice flashes, and suddenly I'm looking at my desktop. I can't tell if the export stopped or the window just went away.
The app disappears whenever I open my account page, and just before it goes I catch a notice saying “Something went wrong.” It happens too fast to read the rest.
I was halfway through sending a message when the whole app closed; a “Message couldn't be sent” banner was visible for a second as it vanished.
The game shuts itself down a few seconds after I open it. There's no warning or other notice—it just takes me back to my desktop.
My notes app keeps vanishing while I'm typing, and then I'm back on my phone's home screen. I don't see any notice before it closes.
I’m entering the password I use every day, but the app keeps sending me back to the login screen. Could you check whether there’s an issue with my account?
I’ve double-checked my username and password, and both are right, but I still get an error when I try to access my account. This started this morning.
My usual password is being rejected, even though I’m sure it’s correct. I tried the “forgot password” link, but I’d really like someone to figure out why I can’t get in.
I can’t get past the login page with the password I’ve been using for months. I wondered if making a new one would help, but first I want to know why this one suddenly stopped working.
I’m locked out and the password I have saved isn’t getting me anywhere. I can’t tell whether I need to make a new password or if something else is wrong.
I’ve tried a few times to access my account, but no luck. Should I update my password, or is there another problem with the login?
I can still get into my account on my phone, but I’d like to replace my password with a new one. The website keeps rejecting it when I try to sign in there.
I want to update my password, but I’m stuck at the account page because it won’t accept the one I’m using now. Can you help me sort this out?
I’m already logged in and everything is working, but I’d like to choose a new password for better security. Where can I update it?
Could you tell me how to change my account password? I’m not having trouble accessing the account; I just want to use a different one.
My tracking says the package left the sorting center two days ago, but there haven’t been any updates since. Could you check its progress and let me know when it’s expected to arrive?
I placed this order last week and it still shows as being prepared. Do you have an updated estimate for when it will ship?

The tracking page says it’s still on the way, though I got a notification earlier that made it sound like it might have been dropped off. I haven’t spotted anything outside—could you check the latest status and the expected arrival?
It was supposed to come yesterday, but the tracking hasn’t changed from “out for delivery.” I checked the porch just in case; can you see whether it’s still coming today?
The tracking shows a delivery scan from this afternoon, but the page also says the package is still due tomorrow. Nothing has turned up yet—could you help me figure out what’s happening?

I got a notice that my package may have been left at the address, but the tracking still lists it as moving through the network. I can’t tell if I should keep looking around or wait for another update.
The tracking says it was dropped off this morning, but I’ve checked the front step and mail area and there’s nothing there. Could you look into it and let me know if it might still show up later?
I received a delivery confirmation, but the package isn’t in the usual spot and my neighbors haven’t seen it. Can you check where the driver left it, or whether there’s another stop still to come?
The carrier marked my order as delivered yesterday, but I never got it. I checked around the entrance and with my neighbors, and it’s nowhere to be found.
I got a delivery notification an hour ago, but there’s no package at my door or in the building’s parcel room. Please investigate the delivery.
Could you send me a downloadable file of the information associated with my account, including my profile details and activity history? I’m organizing my records.
I’d like to receive a copy of the information you keep on my account, preferably in a format I can save. Please let me know how to get it.
After seeing my searches influence the recommendations I get, I’m uneasy about what’s retained. Could you send me a copy of the information linked to my account?
I don’t love that my location seems to affect the offers I see, but first I’d like a downloadable copy of the details and activity you have associated with me.
I noticed the recommendations seem connected to things I’ve looked at. Can you tell me what information you have about me and how it factors into those suggestions?
An old address of mine appeared in a recent interaction, which caught me off guard. I’d like to understand what details of mine are on file and what they’re being used for.
It’s unsettling that an ad seemed to reflect something I only discussed near my phone. Could you show me which account details or activity might have shaped it?
I never expected my browsing to affect the offers I receive, and I’m uncomfortable with that. Please show me the profile categories you’ve linked to my account so I can understand what’s driving it.
Why are you using my purchase history to target me with ads? It feels invasive, and I want that practice stopped.
I turned off personalized recommendations, but the app still seems to use my activity to tailor what I see. This is frustrating and makes me question how my information is being handled.
My profile now has a different email and phone number, and there are posts I never made. Someone’s clearly been using it as me.
I got an alert that my password was changed, but I didn’t change it. Now the recovery details belong to somebody else.
I can’t get into my profile, and the password reset goes to an email I don’t recognize. The screen says access is temporarily restricted, too.
My account suddenly stopped letting me sign in, and I received a notification about a new device in another country. It also says I need to contact support before access can be restored.
I can’t sign in, and the app says access is unavailable after a security check. I don’t know if something changed on my profile or if there’s a problem with my account.
This morning I was asked to verify my identity and then couldn’t get past the sign-in screen. I haven’t received any explanation, so I’m not sure what happened.
I got a notice that my account has been suspended, and I can’t use it right now. There was also a sign-in alert I don’t recognize, so I’m wondering if that’s related.
My access was disabled after what the app called unusual activity. I did see a login notice from a device I don’t use, but I don’t know whether anyone actually got into my account.
I received a message saying my account has been suspended for violating the community rules. I haven’t been able to use any of its features since.
The app says my account is temporarily disabled while a billing issue is reviewed. I’m just trying to find out when access will be restored.
I got an email saying my account was opened from a phone in Prague last night, but I was asleep and have never been there. I can still sign in normally.
There’s a session listed from a Windows computer I don’t own. I didn’t log in yesterday, and I’d like to know how to end that session.
I saw a notice that someone signed in from a new browser while I was at work. The code prompt mentioned in the email sounds familiar, but I didn’t try to access my account.
My account history shows a successful visit from another country, which definitely wasn’t me. I do use an authenticator app, and it hasn’t given me any trouble.
I received an alert about an access attempt just as a code prompt appeared on my phone. I’m not sure whether I’m having trouble getting in or should be worried about the alert.
The account page is asking me to verify something, and I also got a notice about a new session. I can’t tell whether the verification step is failing or the session notice is the real issue.
I can’t get into my account because the codes from my authenticator keep being rejected. There was also a login notice from a city I don’t recognize, though I’m not sure when that happened.
My phone was replaced yesterday, and now the account keeps asking for a code I can’t generate. I noticed an unfamiliar device in the security page while trying to sort it out.

The six-digit numbers in my authenticator app aren’t accepted, even though I’m entering them right away. I can access the account from another device, but I’m stuck at the verification screen on this one.
I switched to a new phone and can’t get the authenticator set up for my account. Could you help me reconnect it or use another way to verify?
The settings page looks really cramped now—the labels overlap the toggles, and the save button is almost cut off at the bottom.
Since the update, the text in my inbox is tiny and the columns are all squished together. It’s hard to read, but everything still opens normally.
On my phone, the checkout button is partly offscreen and a little “Please wait” notice sits underneath it, though I can still place the order.
The dashboard cards are stacked on top of each other, and a red “Try again” banner keeps appearing even though the numbers seem to load.
When I submit the form, the fields shift down and a “Request couldn’t be completed” notice appears at the bottom; I can’t tell whether it went through.
After I pick a date, the calendar disappears and the page shows a blank panel with “Oops” at the edge. I’m not sure if my selection saved or if the screen just failed to update.
Saving my profile fails with “Unable to update” every time, and the dialog also jumps halfway off the screen when I click save.
I can’t export the report because it says “Download failed”; the notice pops up over the buttons and is hard to dismiss.
Every time I try to reset my password, it says “Link expired” and won’t send me a new one.
Uploading my invoice stops at 80% and then says “File processing failed.” I’ve tried the same file a few times.
Could you add a connection to Monday.com? We’re moving our project tracking there and don’t see a way to bring those boards into your app.
It would save us a lot of copying if your service could send updates to Freshdesk. Is support for that on your roadmap?

We’re using Airtable for inventory, and right now I have to export a CSV every morning to keep your dashboard current. A direct connection would help, especially since Airtable changed its API recently.
Could your app connect with Linear? Our team has been passing issue links around by hand, and we’re hoping to get status updates into the same place without all the extra steps.

I’m trying to get our Salesforce records showing up in your workspace, but nothing is coming through. I thought we already had this set up, though our admin says it may have been handled by an old custom workflow.
Can you help me get the connection to Teams sorted out? Messages aren’t appearing in the project feed, and I’m not sure whether we had this working before or just planned to set it up.
Our HubSpot sync is still running, but it stopped bringing over company notes last week. Could you also include call summaries while you’re looking at it?

The connection to QuickBooks has been dropping invoices since yesterday, even though it’s still pulling customer names across. It would be great if it could include refunds too once the current issue is fixed.
The Slack connection that’s been working for us for months stopped posting alerts this morning. I’ve reauthorized it twice, but new alerts still aren’t showing up.
Our Google Drive files used to appear in the document picker, but the list has been empty since Tuesday. Nothing changed with our permissions, and reconnecting the account hasn’t helped.
Please switch off my Plus plan before it renews next week. I still want to keep my login and saved projects.
I’m no longer using the paid tier, so please stop the monthly charge. Don’t remove my profile—I may come back later.
I’m trying to cut expenses, so please end my Pro access and stop billing me. I’d also like my profile to look inactive, but I don’t need it removed.
Could you make sure I won’t be charged for this service again? I’m taking a break from the site and would prefer my personal page not show up publicly.
I’m ready to be done with this service. Please shut down whatever needs to be shut down so I won’t have to deal with it anymore.
Can you close things out for me? I don’t want to keep using this, and I’m not sure whether that means removing my profile or stopping the recurring charge.
I want my profile and its stored information removed for good. I’m also paying for an extra feature, so please make sure that doesn’t keep running afterward.
Please close my presence on the site and wipe my personal details. I noticed a monthly charge recently, so I’d like that handled as part of this too.
Please remove my profile and all the personal information attached to it. I’m on the free plan, so there’s no billing to change.
I want my account and its data permanently erased, including my messages and profile details. I don’t have any paid services with you.
I got a password-reset email for an account I didn’t try to access, and support says there was a sign-in from another country. Can you check whether someone got into my account details?
A caller knew the address and phone number I used only on your site, and I’ve also seen unfamiliar login alerts. I’m worried someone may have gotten hold of my customer records.

I signed up for your service last week, and now I’m getting convincing messages that use the same details I gave you. I don’t know if someone saw my information or if it’s being shared with marketing partners, but I want to know how it got out.

My account page showed a device I don’t recognize, and afterward I started receiving ads tied to a health issue I searched for in your app. Did someone access my profile, or is the app using those details to target me?

I keep getting calls that seem connected to things I’ve entered in your app, and I can’t tell whether that’s because another company has seen the information or because your systems are putting it to use. Could you explain what’s going on?

A few details I shared with your service have started showing up in places I didn’t expect. I’m not sure whether someone outside your company got them or whether they’re being used in a way I never agreed to.
Why am I seeing ads based on private notes I saved in your app? It feels like those details are being passed around, and I’d like to know who can see them.

I gave your service my location so it could provide directions, not so it could build a profile of where I go. I’ve also noticed unfamiliar activity on my account, so please tell me what’s being done with that location history.

I’m uncomfortable that your app uses my purchase history to personalize offers, especially since I never opted into that. Please turn off that kind of targeting and tell me how to remove the profile you’ve built.

I provided my email address to receive receipts, but now your company sends me promotional messages and shares offers based on my browsing habits. I want my information used only to provide the service I signed up for.
